item.title: Version 1.5.75
item.description:
✨ v1.5.75 Update

  • ✍️ Inline AI Prompt actions can now type the answer straight into your text field. Turn on Type Result Directly in the action's Output setting to skip the Inline AI panel.
  • ✨ A small indicator next to the cursor shows while AI is thinking or typing. Press Esc to stop.
  • 📋 If you switch to another app while AI is typing, OnText stops typing and copies the full answer to the clipboard.
